notes.title: Five Day Detective Demo Launch
notes.notes:
So, the Five Day Detective demo was due for release in October 2023, then it got set back, and set back and... set back some more.

But now, the demo is out (really!), and we want people to play the thing.

So, if you have any interest in quirky puzzle-solving adventure games, or simply want to support a lovingly crafted indie game, please test it out, wishlist, offer constructive criticism, or just generally let us know what you think.

Also: do you consider this game to be a point and click? (and if not, then what?) It uses PnC mechanics but you control Inspector Dermot Dervish with a controller or keyboard. Coder Mike and I can't agree on this, so I'd like to throw it out there.

Cheers,
Dominic O'Reilly
Krunchy Fried Games
